fact: The Libyan Center for Freedom of the Press released, on 30 December, a research paper on the legal framework of the digital space and its impact on elections in Libya, produced with International IDEA in coordination with the High National Elections Commission.
title: إطلاق ورقة بحثيّة جديدة حول الإطار القانوني للفضاء الرقمي وتأثيره على الانتخابات في ليبيا
